notes.title: True Ballistics: Real Calibers — Ultimate Combat
notes.content:
[b]True Ballistics: Real Calibers — Ultimate Combat[/b]

Get ready for the most intense update yet! Unleash the power of realistic ballistics with true-to-life calibers—every shot feels powerful and authentic, adding a new layer of depth and strategy to your gameplay.

[b]Just a taste of some of the available calibers:[/b]

[list]
[*] 9x19mm
[*] 7.62x39mm
[*] .357 SIG
[*] 5.56x45mm
[*] 5.7x28mm
[*] 5.45x39mm
[*] .303 British
[*] 8mm Lebel
[*] .30-06 Springfield
[*] 7.92x33mm Kurz
[/list]

Dominate the battlefield with the introduction of three formidable factions: the diverse, wacky, and unpredictable Battle Royale faction, the precise and disciplined Samurai faction, and the brutal and unyielding Viking faction.

[b]Just some of the new weapons:[/b]

[list]
[*] Desert Eagle
[*] Barrett M82
[*] AK-12
[*] FAMAS
[*] Chinchilla
[*] SKS
[*] Odachi
[*] Kunai
[*] AK-74
[*] M134
[*] Jumonji Yari
[/list]

The overhauled combat system enhances realism and consistency, ensuring every clash is fluid and immersive. Plus, enjoy a host of miscellaneous bug fixes and optimizations that make your experience smoother and more intense. This update is packed with features that will elevate your gameplay to the next level.

[b]Are you ready to battle?[/b]
